settings.notes: daily_calorie_goal and daily_protein_goal_g are optional — set them by telling Claude e.g. 'set my daily calorie goal to 2200' or 'set my protein goal to 160'. protein_goal was set using a bodyweight-based heuristic (0.8-1g per lb) for lifting-while-in-a-deficit, at ~189lb — recalculate if bodyweight changes meaningfully. timezone controls how dates/times are stamped on entries — tell Claude your timezone to set it once.
